summary: Next.js App Router SDK that integrates Barkpark content fetching with Next 15's RSC/client boundary, draft-mode preview, and tag-based cache invalidation. It exports separate server, client, webhook, draft-mode, revalidate, and preload subpaths to keep the react-server module graph clean.

intentions.title: Preserve Next 15 RSC boundary: no client APIs in the server graph
intentions.evidence: server/core.ts explicitly never re-exports BarkparkLive/BarkparkLiveProvider; tsup.config.ts only prepends 'use client' to client.{mjs,cjs} and actions.{mjs,cjs}, not server; server/index.ts imports 'server-only'

intentions.title: Tag-based cache invalidation that round-trips with webhook-driven revalidation
intentions.evidence: server/core.ts builds scoped tag prefixes (bp:ws:<ws>:p:<project>:ds:<dataset>) for force-cache fetches, auto-tags by type and doc id, and explicitly avoids next.tags on no-store (ADR-004) so tags match what the webhook bridge fires

intentions.title: Draft-mode preview with server-token auth and auto-reissue
intentions.evidence: barkparkFetchInner branches on draftMode().isEnabled: adds perspective=drafts, Authorization Bearer, cache:'no-store', and retries once via cfg.reissuePreviewToken on 401

intentions.title: Multi-workspace/project scoping for multi-tenant deployments
intentions.evidence: resolveScopePrefix and resolveTagPrefix in server/core.ts layer server-config workspace/project over the client config, emitting /w/<ws>/p/<project> URL prefixes and matching bp:ws:...:p:... cache tag prefixes

intentions.title: Structured error taxonomy surfaced to Next.js consumers
intentions.evidence: decodeAndThrow in server/core.ts maps HTTP status codes to typed BarkparkNotFoundError, BarkparkAuthError, BarkparkRateLimitError, BarkparkNetworkError, BarkparkAPIError from @barkpark/core

intentions.title: Correct dual-format (CJS+ESM) build with directive injection
intentions.evidence: tsup.config.ts outputs both .cjs and .mjs for all entry points, then post-processes client/actions chunks to prepend 'use client' which esbuild strips, restoring the directive Next 15 requires
